summary: An agency or employer talks about 'employees identified for layoff' and never says the person's name.
realLife: Workers said they were referred to in impersonal terms, never named, and some were told almost nothing about reasons, notice, or what happens to their work.
sources: Marketplace, employees share how they got laid off (2022): http://www.marketplace.org/story/2022/11/16/name-mix-ups-and-callous-hr-directors-employees-share-how-they-got-laid-off
inGame: the job-ended event can be worded by the employer type; needs: severance and notice-period records

turns.summary: A manager calls the worker by name and says sorry it ended this way.
turns.writesBack: a lasting good word; a possible later reference

turns.summary: HR hands over papers and a job-board link.
The worker is called by the wrong name on the call and says so.
turns.writesBack: a small bitter story told to friends
